description: Finds Sri Lanka Post offices and postal codes. Search by post office name, 5-digit post code, short (tele) code, or a village or town name. Returns the post code, type, grade, whether it delivers, its division, phone numbers and, for a sub post office, the controlling post office. If no office matches the name, villages matching it are returned with the post offices serving their area.

query.description: Post office name ("Kandy"), post code ("20000"), short code, or village/town name ("Peradeniya").

name: find-post-office
title: Find post office
